g.text: DSP score distributions and validation-selected thresholds
Saved W = 1 scores · boxes: IQR and median · whiskers: full range
DSP scores remain separable (ROC-AUC = 1.0 in every current evaluation).
Threshold transfer fails for unseen 2 mm and 3 mm flaws (folds 1 and 2).
Each line is a separate fold’s validation-selected threshold; labels identify its test source.
All 3,558 no-flaw rows contain the same raw image.
